title: MV Power Master: A Strange Journey MV

posts.author: Power Master
posts.body:
Apparently, I never posted about my game here before. Or at least, a search isn't pulling anything up. (If I did make a thread before, it'd be very outdated, so just delete it if it exists lol)
Anyway, been working on an RPG (shocker) over the past... almost decade. Still not done, but it's coming along! The overall summary is, you are the descendant of Legendary Heroes. On the thousandth anniversary of them saving the world, the bad guy, Exitous, returns from the Paradox Dimension. Your goal is to gather the 26 Gems before he does, and he is actively searching for them. The order you get the Gems in impacts how towns respond. For example, recruitable characters could be missed or a town could be destroyed if you take too long.
The game is in active development. I'm shooting for a late 2026 release, but it's not 100% solidified.
* 19 main recruitable characters, with some quest characters able to join temporarily.
* 26 towns, each with their own story, environment, and challenges.
* Hand-drawn portraits and pixel battle sprites.
* Original tilesets, characters, enemies, and story.
* Flexible outcomes depending on your progress. Play multiple times for different outcomes!
Things I plan to improve:
* Animation assets are provided by the RPG Maker MV engine.
* Music was artificially generated many years ago, but they are just placeholders.
* The characters Stephan, Jennifer, Hamilton, and Helen can have their roles changed, but the final product will have Stephan as the central hero.
* EDIT: Story progression is almost non-existent in the demo. While the game is based on open-world exploration, the beginning area of Fora cannot be skipped in the final game.
* EDIT: Enemy balancing is weird in the demo, am fixing.
There is a demo available, with 8 towns and 11 characters. You can check it out here:
https://powermaster.itch.io/pmmv-demo
I am not the greatest artist, so some things may look a little wonky. But I'm doing my best, and I'm liking how things are coming together so far. Comments and suggestions are welcome ^_^
I will update this thread whenever I have something more to share. You can find other links to things I do here:
https://powermaster.itch.io/

posts.author: Meowsticks
posts.body:
Hey!
First of all, great job! As someone who has also been working over a decade on my game, I know that journey. It is not easy, but I want to give you props for sticking through it! I hope you keep working!
I played the demo, for about half an hour. I'd tell you how far I got, but I don't really know how to answer that question. First, I like the art. It's cute, it's got style. There is some good humor in the game too. Some dialogue made me laugh.
I started the game, and ended up recruitng Lynmandi, Alice, and Octavius. I didn't do any dungeons, just kind of wandered around, ended up at Xora, looked a telescope and ending up on the moon? Wandered around for a while, fought Galactrila (for some reason my entire party was at 1HP???) and only won because Octavius was too strong to be hurt. That was basically it.
I think this is an extremely ambitious project with the concept you're going for, and I believe you can make it work. But playing through it and there things that just didn't work or feel right, and after thinking on it, it all boils down to one thing: Structure.
There is no structure in this game (maybe that's just a demo thing idk??). I started, was giving a really cool backstory with awesome art, and was set free and told to go get a gem from the forest temple.
I didn't do that, I just left and nothing stopped me at all. (By the way, I only know the story because of what you wrote here, just playing the game and I have no idea wtf was going on. NPCs were telling me things like "you want my gem??" and I was like "????"). I think the game would be improved vastly if you made Fora required to do before being allowed to leave. Use that time to teach the basic tech, learn the story, set up everything, and THEN set people free to do things however they please. (Look at most open world games, they all do this(BotW Great Plataeu, FF7 Rebirth Nibel flashback, etc)).
Also I just randomly found a quest about Hide and Seek, and accepting it disabled my menu for 10 minutes meaning I couldn't change equipment, or even SAVE THE GAME. Anyway I feel like I'm rambling again...
I like the idea, I see what you are going for, and it 100% has potential, but it needs structure. The player needs to have some direction. I like the freedom and variability you are going for, but there has to be something for players to latch onto at the beginning.
I'll be keeping an eye on this, I hope you keep improving! You've done a good job with what I played (I know there is a LOT I didn't do too, if I ever have free time again I might go back to it). Best of luck, I believe in ya!

posts.author: Power Master
posts.body:
Thanks for playing! Yes, Octavis is very strong lol
At the time of the demo's release (2024), the story has not been properly finalized yet. I have the plot points down, but most have not been implemented. Because of this, I chose to make the demo more open world to just get it out there until the project is finalized. The final game will be a bit more strict with where you can go (you cannot leave the first town until you get the first Gem, for example), and a new demo will be created to better represent this. The story will be better explained this way.
I'm also aware balancing is... not the greatest. I apologize for some insanely weak or insanely strong enemies, I am working on that lol

Some quests are not finalized yet, and there is a notice when you accept them that it isn't finished. I plan on adding a better way to see what quests you have accepted.

posts.author: Power Master
posts.body:
Spent a lot of time with bug fixes and trying to get certain scripts to work, but I finally finished another town!
The Town of Jora is also called the Town of Trash. It has fallen into complete disarray due to a negligent Guardian. South of it is a landfill, with an incinerator that burns excess trash.
In this town, I had to disable the autotile function (hold Shift) in order to mesh the dirt and stone paths together. There aren't many residents in this town, but the incinerator level is one of my favorites and will be a mechanical beast to put together.

posts.author: Power Master
posts.body: In Jora Incinerator, there are many valves you have to turn in order to close off the steam pressure. You have to walk along pipes and avoid damaging junk tiles; one wrong step can be painful.

posts.author: Power Master
posts.body:
Scrappergeist is a boss of Jora Junkyard, composed of shards of metal with an inner skeleton of garbage.
By the way, some bosses in certain areas will be different depending on the number of Gems you have when you encounter them.
(Battle background is a work in progress lol)

posts.author: Power Master
posts.body:
Swid is a squid that makes its home in sewers. It attacks the player to prevent them from destroying the sewerage plant in Pora. However, the toxic fumes will continue poisoning the player characters and makes it difficult to hit enemies.
(Health bar will be repositioned at a later date.)

posts.author: Power Master
posts.body:
The Town of Yora is a festive town, filled with games for people to enjoy. The biggest attraction is a tournament, which Stephan needs to partake in to obtain the Yora Gem.
This area has the most amount of new assets that need to be created, so it may take me a while.
Updated to be more colorful now:

posts.author: Power Master
posts.body:
The Yora Tournament draws in many people, some of which you'll be fighting against! Many new characters were drawn for this setting, including their field, portrait, and battlers graphics, which is why this area took me a while to get through.
Silver Knight, the first boss you fight in the Fora Temple, also received a graphical update.

posts.author: Power Master
posts.body:
The state of the Town of Hora varies depending on when you arrive. It can be either a lush green town, or one flaming and damaged.
You'll also meet a girl named Sobie, who seems to have a negative history with your ancestor.

posts.author: SanctiFire
posts.body:
Just got through the demo!
Combat wise I got really lucky to find a great combo. Pink haired Tsundere princess lady + the bombarda spell. Wiping almost every enemy turn 1-3 lol. Every single town has personality, and there are going to be 26 of them? One for each letter of the alphabet. Very cool stuff.
Favorite characters were the pink haired Tsundere and the really weird quiet girl. Great dialog especially on the quiet girl lol. Favorite boss fight was the clock boss fight. Loved the scenery, the animation out in the distance and the intrigue. Best character design was the mysterious stranger. Very cool.
I'm also a fan of the little things. The first town being so homely that everyone knows and talks about each other was really cool. The lady that kicks you out of the bathroom was funny. The quest where you take the shopkeepers role was great, adds a slice of life element to the game. The only way to wake up the old man is the least crazy option haha. Dungeon puzzles gave me a pokemon vibe the way they were set up. Being able to choose your protagonist at the beginning and send your upcoming partners to different towns and roles was really interesting.
Overall, I'm really rooting for you to get this game out there. The experience was fun, playing games like this reminds me of the old days where you couldn't use a strategy guide lol.
As far as bugs go, here are a couple just so you don't have to find them later.
- One of the bookcases didn't have collision in the mining town I believe
- Octavious(?) didn't proceed the quest on a "yes" answer. He did proceed on a "no" answer, but only if I wasn't standing below him. I got softlocked when I was standing below him.

I think the bosses are also coming together quite well. My favorite little thing is being able to use the toilets lol

posts.author: Power Master
posts.body:
Hora Headquarters serves as the main defense between the northern boarder of Moneo and the southern boarder of Shadurn. It is outfitted with searchlights and lasers, and patrolled by several armed guardsmen. It was built during an invasion many years ago, and now also protects the Hora Gem.
If you collected the Bora Gem already, you may find yourself facing a familiar opponent...

posts.author: Power Master
posts.body:
Meet Stan. He's a rugged-looking man with a taste for adventure and a funny way of talking. And he's also a mercenary, which means he'll only join your team if you pay him! How much you pay him could determine how well he does on your team.
And also one of the maps of Eora Everlasting I forgot to share earlier lol

posts.author: Power Master
posts.body: Hunter is a man who claims to be the grandson of Exitous. And connecting yourself to the main villain tends to not go well (he's in jail).

posts.author: Power Master
posts.body:
As you work to rebuild a bridge to Iora Island, you'll come across a girl named Kyra. After you rescue her from near death, she'll take off and get captured, where she'll need rescuing again.
There's also the possibility of her not surviving her injuries if you take too long...

posts.author: Power Master
posts.body:
Helen tells you Dora has been kidnapped, and it turns out Helen is also your cousin! She's not too sure of herself, but once the Guardian of Dora has been safely returned, Helen will join you on your quest.
That's everyone! Experience all of these characters and their stories when Power Master: A Strange Journey MV releases in full!

posts.author: Power Master
posts.body:
Since the forums will enter read-only mode soon, I'll make one last update here.
Development is progressing smoothly, 24 out of 26 towns are done. The last remaining two involve endgame material, so I won't be showing them off too much. Afterwards, it's getting all the side quests done and making music (somehow lol).
I've been on these forums ever since I first started with RPG Maker VX Ace back in 2015, asking for random (sometimes easily solvable) help as an RPG Maker noob. Thanks for all the help and support over the years, and happy game making!
If you still want to be more in the know of what I do, you can check out my links down below. I don't know if I can do a Discord link (we got six days left, I can break the rules, right?), but DM me if you want that, too.
